# 2 Baruch Chapter 21 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**21:1** And-I went-forth and-sat in-the-cave of-the-earth in-the-valley of-Kidron, and-I-fasted there seven days.

**21:2** And-after seven days, I-lifted my-eyes toward-heaven, and-I-opened my-mouth, and-I-said:

**21:3** O LORD my-God, you-who-called the-beginning [into-being] from-before-[the]-world-ages, and-the-world-ages [stood] before-you, and-the-passing-away of-the-ages [is] in-your-hand —

**21:4** You-whose-throne [stands] in-the-heights [that are] beyond-reckoning, and-whose-glory [is] beyond-all-searching-out —

**21:5** Before-whom the-host-[armies] of-the-angels stand trembling, and-they-serve [you] with-trembling-and-with-fire before-your-glory —

**21:6** To-whom there-is no-beginning, and-to-whom there-is no-end; who-sustained the-living-ones by-your-word, and-who-called-forth the-dead-ones by-your-command —

**21:7** You-who-appointed over-the-living their-numbers, and-over-the-dead their-limits; who-does-not-permit the-kings to-transgress [your-commandments] —

**21:8** You-who-remember all-things, and-who-forget-not any-thing among-the-things-that-have-been-created —

**21:9** Hear, O LORD, my-prayer, and-give-heed to-my-cry.

**21:10** For we-are, all-of-us, not-many [compared] to-you, and-we-are as-though we-were-not [at all], and-like-a-drop from-a-bucket [are we].

**21:11** And-like-a-morning-mist we-vanish, and-our-strength [is] as-a-vapor.

**21:12** And-in-your-goodness [are ordered] our-days, and-in-the-compassion-of your-right-hand [are numbered] our-years.

**21:13** For the-Most-High [is] great, and-the-Mighty-One [is] powerful; [and he] has-not-forgotten [even] one among-the-sons-of-men.

**21:14** O LORD, behold! You-have-heard the-prayer of-those-who-have-fallen-asleep, and-you-are [one]-who-is-to-be-feared before-the-departed.

**21:15** Has-it-not-been written in-former-times by-the-mouth-of-the-prophets, saying: Behold, the-days-are-coming when-the-Most-High will-visit the-world which-he-made?

**21:16** And-he-will-make-a-reckoning from-those-who-have-transgressed the-commandment; and-he-will-judge the-living by-means-of the-dead, and-he-will-requite those-who-have-transgressed with-the-fruits-of their-transgression.

**21:17** And-he-will-raise-up those-who-were-sleeping [in-the-dust]; and-he-will-bring-forth the-living-ones who-have-waited [for-him]; and-he-will-bring-in those-who-were-sealed to-the-treasury-[of-souls], to-sit-[down].

**21:18** And-then shall-he-destroy those-who-have-corrupted-themselves, and-he-will-deliver those-who-have-polluted-themselves to-the-fire.

**21:19** And-when-he-has-subjected everything-that-is-corruptible and-has-renewed-the-age and-has-revived those-who-were-sleeping in-the-hope-of-him —

**21:20** Then-shall-come his-rest, [which-was-spoken-of].

**21:21** For you-alone are-able to-do-this; and-I-speak before-you.

**21:22** For your-furnace [is] full, and-the-abundance-of your-compassion is-withheld from-those-who-are-now living.

**21:23** But-if-you-had-compassion on-those-who-are-now [alive], and-if-you-had-hastened your-times and-had-shortened the-measure-of the-ages —

**21:24** You-would-not-have-kept-empty your-treasure, [and] the-coming-age would-not-have-been-so-long delayed.

**21:25** For great-is your-strength, O LORD, and-great [is] your-glory; great [is] your-beauty, and-great [is] your-grace, and-great [is] your-compassion. Amen, amen.

**21:26** And-after-this I-sat there seven [more] days.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac Codex Ambrosianus. Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text. Chapter 21 is Baruch's extended intercessory prayer from the cave in the Kidron valley, appealing to God's sovereignty over time, the dead, and the coming age.*
